notes: Variant WLC.2KI.16.15.v002 is underdetermined and resolved to r00-base, covering s001-s002; the projection's waw and piel are aligned as ordinary tokens and no textual decision is made here.
The waw of וְאֵת עֹלַת כָּל־עַם is rendered with under rule 14's open list rather than left added.

In the burnt offering of all the people the relational of goes to the quantifier כֹּל as the chain's rectum, since the ASV writes no of between all and the people; each of the three written the's is counted against the morpheme standing before its own word under rule 29.
